sourceWarnings.summary: The source presents numerical candidates for optimal anticoherence order, not proved maxima. Its numerical acceptance criterion is a purity-based anticoherence measure within 10^-25 of 1.
The introductory exceptions 29, 87, 94 concern matching spherical-design orders. Actual published lower-order records exist for (29, 5), (87, 11), (94, 12), flagged(*).
The reported best near-6-AC state for 29 qubits has measure approximately 1-3×10^-8. It is not a 6-AC witness, and failure to find one is not nonexistence proof.

General files provide Cartesian Majorana coordinates and complex Dicke coefficients; Dicke columns are real and imaginary components. This source excerpt does not explicitly specify the row orientation, which should be independently checked.

Degenerate records are numerical candidates. The final filename integer means at least one Majorana point has that multiplicity; it does not specify the entire partition or prove maximum multiplicity.
Anticoherence and spherical-design conditions are inequivalent. No spherical-design files are included.

All files were imported from local counterparts matching the exact filenames linked in the saved primary-page HTML. The live server timed out, so current online byte identity is unverified. Additional local higher-order or otherwise unpublished filenames are excluded.
